At the summit of Mount Tai, eighteen masters from both land and water gathered, yet all wore grim expressions. For within this year, the martial world had suffered two earth-shattering calamities.
The first occurred at the beginning of the year, when the entire family of the martial alliance leader, Yu Wen Yue, along with over a hundred guards and servants in his manor, were slaughtered overnight—not a single soul survived.
The second happened not long ago, when the head of the Gao family from Tianhe, Gao Qun, was pierced through the heart by a sudden appearance of a white-haired demonic figure, dying on the spot. This white-haired madman, though erratic, possessed bizarre martial skills. The remaining experts of the Gao family surrounded him but could not subdue him, as he broke through their encirclement with overwhelming palm strikes and vanished without a trace.
Both tragedies claimed the lives of renowned figures in the martial world, plunging all into fear. If these two atrocities were indeed the work of that white-haired demon, he could truly be called a fiend!
Lu Yuan, a wandering disciple of the Mohist school, stood among the gathered masters and lightly tapped the massive mechanical chest she had carried all this way.
"That fiend... it couldn’t be you, could it?"
Inside the chest lay the unconscious white-haired Patient she had rescued days prior. Due to his conspicuous hair, she had hidden him within.
At first, there was no sound from the chest. But after the masters had debated for a long while, the Patient suddenly transmitted his voice as a thin thread into Lu Yuan’s ear.
"Leave first. There’s someone I must kill."
Lu Yuan was stunned—she had indeed saved the fiend. Just as she was about to dissuade him, the fiend burst out of the chest. In a flash, he seized one person from the crowd and ended their life with a single strike!
The masters atop the summit rallied to attack the fiend, yet for a time, none could subdue him!
"That Mohist disciple travels with him—she must be involved! Capture her first for questioning!"
Hearing this, the white-haired fiend, who had already fought his way out, turned back into the fray. Shielding Lu Yuan, he endured countless wounds to break free once more.
That night, they took refuge in a dilapidated temple. Lu Yuan angrily scolded the white-haired fiend for his indiscriminate killing. Yet the invincible fiend of the day could only weep silently in response. Seeing the wounds he bore for her sake, Lu Yuan’s heart softened, and she asked for his reasons.
"If I tell you, will you believe me?"
The white-haired fiend knew his appearance was now far from ordinary and doubted Lu Yuan would trust him.
